FIRE SPRINKLERS
RECORD ARE DOCUMENTED BY THAT PURVEYOR AS HAVING BEEN MET BY THE APPLICANT(S). 2022 CFC
SEC. 903.3.5 AND HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE 13114.7
WILDLAND URBAN INTERFACE
THIS PROJECT IS IN A WILDLAND-URBAN INTERFACE FIRE AREA AND REQUIRES MATERIALS AND
CONSTRUCTION METHODS FOR EXTERIOR WILDFIRE EXPOSURE PER CHAPTER R337 IN THE CRC.
ADDRESS NUMBERS SHALL CONTRAST WITH THEIR BACKGROUND AND BE VISIBLE FROM THE
STREET. THE MINIMUM STROKE. (16 CFC 505.1, 505.1.1, 505.1.2)
FIRE PROTECTION DURING CONSTRUCTION SHALL BE PROVIDED BEFORE COMBUSTIBLES ARRIVE AT THE
BUILDING. (16 CFC 3315.1)
1.  DEFENSIBLE SPACE SHALL BE MAINTAINED BY THE OWNER
OR OCCUPANT OF THE PREMISES. 2016 CFC 304.1.2, 2016 SFC 304.1.2.1.
2.  VEGETATION MANAGEMENT SHALL COMPLY WITH SECTION 304 OF THE 2010 CALIFORNIA FIRE CODE.
INSPECTION BY A MEMBER OF THE SONOMA VALLEY FIRE RESCUE AUTHORITY. THE FOLLOWING
INSPECTIONS ARE REQUIRED: FIRE CONSTRUCTION FINAL  SCHEDULE OF INSPECTIONS: 707.996.2102
